name: ctx-saver
description: Spend fewer tokens in Claude Code. One mod, no Python: a status line with context, limits, cache countdown and pet; it trims long shell output, blocks generated folders, huge reads, repeat reads and secrets, and answers /savings, /pet, /toggle, /wrapped, /token-audit and /handoff. /saver-setup adds auto-compact at 50% and the .env deny rules.
